title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

description:

Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;

Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);

Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;

Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Consultor(a) de investimentos associado(a)
description:
Se você já atua no mercado financeiro e procura a melhor estrutura para atender seus clientes sem conflito de interesses, com boas perspectivas de carreira e sendo bem remunerado, essa vaga é para você!
Somos uma consultoria de investimentos que atende famílias em busca do crescimento patrimonial e da preservação do legado. Atendemos clientes em todos os grandes bancos e corretoras do Brasil e também nos EUA. Nosso modelo de atuação é 100% FEE BASED sem conflito de interesses.
ALOCAÇÃO: Somos associados ao grupo Nord Investimentos garantindo que as melhores estratégias de alocação estarão à disposição dos seus clientes, ou seja, você terá relatórios e calls de investimento independentes e de alta qualidade.
INDEPENDÊNCIA: Trabalhamos com todos os bancos no Brasil e temos integração com 3 instituições americanas (Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers e Avenue), ou seja, onde quer que seu cliente esteja, você poderá atendê-lo.
EXPERIÊNCIA: Temos um time experiente e com metodologia proprietária que ajuda na conversão de leads (90%) e retenção de clientes (churn menor que 0,50% ao ano).
CARREIRA: Nosso programa de partnership garante que você tenha oportunidade de aumentar sua participação societária no nosso grupo empresarial na medida em que seus resultados e contribuições cresçam. Nossa empresa também possui uma corretora de seguros completa (Monte Bianco Insurance) e uma área com soluções Corporate que atende PJ com empréstimos, cambio, energia e antecipação de recebíveis. Ou seja, aqui você pode oferecer uma oferta completa de produtos e serviços para seus clientes.
Essa proposta de valor em conjunto com nossa metodologia exclusiva tem resultado em mais de 90% de taxa de conversão de leads em clientes.
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes da área de investimentos para ampliar a equipe da Monte Bianco Multi-Family Office (MBM) no Rio de Janeiro. Este cargo demanda a realização de recomendações financeiras especializadas, gerenciamento de carteiras de investimento e interação contínua com clientes para entender suas necessidades e objetivos financeiros. As responsabilidades diárias incluem análise de tendências de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de investimento e fornecimento de um serviço ao cliente de alta qualidade.
Qualificações
Investimentos e Finanças: necessário ter experiência prévia em atender clientes no mercado financeiro.
Relacionamento: garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam compreendidas e atendidas de maneira eficaz.
Prospecção: captação ativa de novos leads e desenvolvimento da estratégias para conversão Caso o candidato não possua nenhuma das certificações exigidas (CEA/CFP/CNPI), será concedido um prazo de 6 meses para que consiga se certificar.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world.
As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees.
On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us! Job challenges: - Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT; - Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation; - Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements; - Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace; - Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses; - Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits; - Participate in emergency response drills and simulations; - Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures; Requirements: - Technical degree in Occupational Safety; - Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry; - Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested; - Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs); - Intermediate Excel skills; - Desirable: Bachelor’s degree; - Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer: - Food allowance; - Transportation allowance without discount; - Health and dental plan at no cost; - Life insurance; - Private pension; - Profit-Sharing; - Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Supervisor(a) de governança - gestão de governança
description:
Requisitos: -Desejável superior completo em Hotelaria ou cursando; -Necessário boa vivência com governança, hotelaria e higienização; -Necessário vivência com gestão de equipes e conhecimento de controle de enxoval.
Atividades: - Planejar e supervisionar as atividades de limpeza e desinfecção no ambiente hospitalar; - Acompanhar processos seletivos e realizar entrevistas de candidatos encaminhados pelos Recursos Humanos para contratação de novos colaboradores da equipe; - Realizar análise de potencial e desempenho, bem como entrevista de feedback; - Realizar em parceria com o RH, por meio de processos seletivos, capacitação e desenvolvimento técnico-profissional, a fim de minimizar custos de headcount e manter o quadro de profissionais qualificados e satisfeitos.
- Realizar reuniões mensais com a empresa de terceirização de limpeza, com objetivo de demonstrar os resultados; - Garantir o preenchimento do SLA, juntamente com a supervisora da empresa terceirizada; - Controlar o fluxo de atividades e implantação de rotinas do setor; - Garantir a guarda segura do mobiliário do hospital e inventário do mesmo; - Coordenar a substituição dos móveis danificados ou sempre que houver a solicitação do responsável de cada setor do hospital; - Acompanhar o controle de indicadores operacionais referentes aos setores sob a sua responsabilidade; - Controlar e gerir banco de horas e escalas da equipe; - Acompanhar a realização do inventário de enxoval e analisar a necessidade de reposição e controle do mesmo; - Garantir, de maneira segura, a guarda de pertences; - Garantir o cumprimento correto de todos os procedimentos padrão do setor, de forma a garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado; - Acompanhar o controle de uniformes da unidade; - Acompanhar o desempenho e avaliação de qualidade percebida dos clientes, de acordo com a ferramenta HFocus..
Outras informações: - Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro.
- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - 08h às 18h (segunda à sexta-feira).
- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Power platform developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil)
JOB OVERVIEW:
Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate).
• Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
• Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and Share Point.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
• Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST).
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.
Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction
- Meeting and exceeding sales targets
- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets
Qualifications
- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries
- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers
- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements
- Fluent in English and Portuguese
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field
- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools
- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?
Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates
This is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results
What you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Especialista de suprimentos
description:
Descrição da Empresa Harsco Environmental é líder global em serviços ambientais e soluções inovadoras para a indústria do aço, com mais de 130 operações ao redor do mundo. Estamos comprometidos em evoluir continuamente para atender tanto às necessidades de nossos clientes quanto dos nossos colaboradores. Priorizamos ambientes de trabalho seguros e sustentáveis, promovendo altos padrões de qualidade. Onde outros enxergam resíduos, vemos valor inexplorado e oportunidades para um futuro sustentável. Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Especialista em Compras para atuar em nossa unidade localizada no Rio de Janeiro, RJ. Este cargo envolve atividades como emissão e acompanhamento de pedidos de compras, análise e avaliação de fornecedores, negociações contratuais e monitoramento de processos de aquisição. O papel exige atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica para garantir a eficiência dos processos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e com necessidade de trabalho presencial. Qualificações Gestão de Pedidos: Experiência em elaboração e acompanhamento de pedidos de compras. Avaliação de Fornecedores e Negociação: Conhecimento em avaliação de fornecedores e negociações contratuais para alinhar custo-benefício e qualidade. Procurement e Análise: Habilidade na gestão de processos de compras e aplicação de habilidades analíticas para tomadas de decisão. Conhecimento de sistemas ERP e proficiência em inglês serão considerados um plus.
Desenvolvimento e homologação de novos fornecedores.
Gestão de contratos nacionais e corporativos (elaboração de minutas, definição de cláusulas, condução de processos de negociação/bid, acompanhamento mensal de prazos, fórmula paramétrica, SLA, renovações e rescisões).
Emissão de BPA (Blanket Purchase Agreement).
Emissão de CPA (Contract Purchase Agreement).
Condução de compras de CAPEX estratégicos.
Apoio na criação, análise e desenvolvimento de KPI’s.

interface com escritórios externos;

controle e cumprimento de prazos.

Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams.
Key Responsibilities

Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure.
Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime).
Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.
Who You Are

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.
Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front).
Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions.
Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services.
Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.
O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.
Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.
Benefícios que oferecemos:

Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

title: Engenheiro de Software Senior (.NET/Observabilidade) | BTG Empresas
description:
Sobre a Área

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) .NET com foco em observabilidade e sustentação para garantir a confiabilidade, rastreabilidade e performance das nossas aplicações backend. Você atuará na instrumentação do código, construção de métricas, dashboards e alertas, além de investigar incidentes em produção com base em dados reais, sempre respeitando boas práticas e compliance de ambientes regulados (ex.: PCI-DSS). Este papel é essencial para manter a operação estável e dar suporte técnico aos times de produto e engenharia, sem assumir responsabilidades típicas de SRE, como gerenciamento de infraestrutura.

No Seu Dia a Dia

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend em .NET (C#), focando em instrumentação para observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Evoluir e manter dashboards, alertas e monitoramentos customizados utilizando DataDog e OpenTelemetry.
  • Trabalhar com golden signals (latência, tráfego, erros e saturação) para padronizar visibilidade dos serviços.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para definição e acompanhamento de SLIs e KPIs.
  • Investigar incidentes e auxiliar na análise de causas raiz com base em dados estruturados de produção.
  • Garantir conformidade das práticas de observabilidade com requisitos regulatórios (PCI-DSS).
  • Automatizar criação e manutenção de dashboards e alertas reutilizáveis (sem responsabilidade sobre infraestrutura).

Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em .NET / C#.
  • Conhecimento prático em DataDog (APM, Logs, Dashboards, Monitors) e ferramentas de instrumentação (OpenTelemetry, DogStatsD).
  • Entendimento dos golden signals aplicados em sistemas distribuídos.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e aplicações escaláveis em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.).
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful.
  • Prática com versionamento Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento em princípios SOLID e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados com foco em auditoria e segurança (ex.: PCI-DSS).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em times multidisciplinares com foco em produto.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou correlatos.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento em outras linguagens como Java, Node.js, Python ou Go, com interesse em atuar com C#.
  • Familiaridade com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experiência em meios de pagamento.
  • Automação de dashboards e alertas via código (IaC para observabilidade).
  • Análise de performance e tuning de aplicações .NET.
  • Participação em processos de melhoria contínua baseados em dados operacionais.
  • Atividades acadêmicas ou extracurriculares relevantes (pós-graduação, MBA, intercâmbio, etc.).

title: Technical Expert

At Etex, our purpose is to inspire new ways of living. We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority. We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Brazil senior condition intelligence (ci & pm)
description:
Company Description
Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.
Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.
Role Description
As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.
In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.
With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.
Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.
Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.
Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.
Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.
Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.
Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.
Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.
Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.
Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.
Qualifications
Experience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.
Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.
Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.
Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.
Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.
Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25: O Grupo Capital: Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.
Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.
Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.
Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital: A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.
Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.
Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia.
Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades: Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.
Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Diferencial: Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa departnershipestruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.
Modo de contratação: Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Engenheiro de dados - júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.
Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras.
Agora comoparte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.
Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas.
Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.
Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.
Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos.
Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.
Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks.
Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico.
Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.
Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines; Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados; Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico; Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises; Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing; Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões; Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting; Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance; Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados; Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados; Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.
Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics); Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks); Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (Data Frames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível); Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas); Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos; Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos); Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza; Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.
Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions).
Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).
Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

Conhecimento avançado em Big Querye Lookere estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados.

Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.
Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
Contratação PJ.
Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.
